intro: Thadius Grimshade is a Wildhammer dwarf diviner dwelling within the mage tower of Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. Though he parted ways with Aerie Peak long ago to study esoteric and darker magical arts, he remains loyal to his kin at heart.

p: Unlike most Wildhammer dwarves who prefer the open skies and roaring winds of the Hinterlands, Thadius Grimshade makes his home inside Nethergarde Keep. Driven by a thirst for arcane divination and darker mystic lore, he relocated to the edge of the tainted Blasted Lands to pursue his esoteric studies. Despite his brooding discipline and separation from his clan, he retains a deep fondness for his homeland and gryphonkind, offering his rare scrying talents to those who come seeking aid on behalf of Aerie Peak.
